subject: VantagePay: console orientation + live lab access
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@vantagepay.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VantagePay console orientation + live lab

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the product overview last week. We're excited to move into a hands-on orientation so our engineering and product teams can try Redwood's console and the API end-to-end. High level ask: a 90-minute session that covers a console walkthrough (routing, model catalog, rollouts) and then a short live-lab where our engineers call the API and validate token, streaming, and model variant fallbacks.

Attendees: Daniel Park (Eng Manager), Priya Singh (Product), same two engineers: Alex Chen (backend) and Sofia Ramos (frontend).

Ideal dates: May 5 or May 6 (PST) in the AM window (9–11am PT). We will need a test workspace, a service account for API keys, and SSO guidance (we use Okta). Are there any preflight steps we should complete on our side?

Also, please confirm whether you can share a short preflight checklist and any sample prompts or scripts we should use for the live lab.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—Daniel
Daniel Park
Engineering Manager, VantagePay
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@vantagepay.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VantagePay console orientation + live lab

Hi Daniel — great to hear. We'd be happy to run the 90-min orientation + lab. Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed May 5, 09:00–10:30 PT
- Thu May 6, 09:30–11:00 PT

Please confirm which slot works and I'll send a calendar invite. A couple of quick preflight items to unblock the lab:
1) Confirm attendee emails for the invite (we need Alex and Sofia).
2) Okta org URL + admin contact (we'll send metadata for SSO).
3) Request a test workspace name (we'll provision a sandbox workspace pinned to the same model variants we'll demo).
4) If you want API keys for automation, please complete the service-account request form (attached).

I've attached a short preflight PDF (VP-Console-Preflight.pdf) that includes the checklist and a recommended set of test prompts for the live lab. Lauren will handle SSO metadata and Dev will lead the live API portion.

Action items:
- Daniel: confirm slot + attendee emails + Okta contact
- VantagePay: complete and return service-account-request-form.pdf if you want API keys created in advance

If neither slot works we can open an afternoon option.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@vantagepay.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@vantagepay.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VantagePay console orientation + live lab

Thanks Jasmine — May 5 (09:00–10:30 PT) works for us. Attendees to add to the invite: alex.chen@vantagepay.com, sofia.ramos@vantagepay.com.

Okta details: idp.vantagepay.okta.com — I'm copying our Okta admin (daniel.park@vantagepay.com will share the SAML metadata directly if required).

We'd like API keys provisioned ahead of the session to speed the live lab. I've attached the signed service-account-request-form and added a short note in the doc listing the scopes we need (tokens.read, models.invoke).

One question: for the service account, do you provision long-lived keys or short-lived tokens (we prefer short-lived). Also, any network/IP allowlist requirements for the sandbox workspace we should be aware of?

Thanks — Priya
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@vantagepay.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VantagePay console orientation + live lab

Hi Priya — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the form.

SSO / Okta: we'll share SAML metadata and an SP-initiated URL. I'll send the XML blob to Daniel's admin (please let us know if you'd prefer a secure share). For onboarding sessions we generally do SP-initiated SSO during the live lab so engineers can verify role mappings in real time.

Service account keys: by default we create short-lived tokens (default TTL 1 hour) and a refresh flow you can integrate with; if you need longer-lived API keys for automation we can issue scoped long-lived keys but they require an AUP signature and an additional review (sounds like you already returned the form which speeds review).

Network allowlist: sandbox workspaces don't require IP allowlisting by default, but if you want us to restrict access we can add a CIDR block — please confirm a public egress IP or range.

I've provisioned the sandbox workspace name: vantagepay-sandbox-20270505. Dev, I'll hand the API portion to you in the session; can you prepare the streaming example and fallback verification script?

Attachments: service-account-request-form.pdf (signed)

—Lauren
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Perfect — May 5, 09:00–10:30 PT is booked. You should see a calendar invite from me shortly (includes a Teams link and the runbook).

Quick notes / where to find things before the session:
- Preflight PDF (attached to this thread): VP-Console-Preflight.pdf
- Sandbox workspace: vantagepay-sandbox-20270505 (already provisioned)
- SSO metadata: Lauren will send the XML to your admin; please expect it by end of day
- Service account: we'll issue a short-lived token during the lab; if you prefer long-lived keys we'll follow up after the AUP review
- Live lab runbook (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-live-lab-runbook-vantagepay

On Fri I'll drop a short pre-session checklist in the runbook so Alex/Sofia can install the client and confirm network egress. Looking forward to the session — we'll keep it hands-on and leave 10 minutes for next steps and a mutual action plan.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
